scope: The current statement and full tangency/uniqueness argument are checked. The exact determinant is proved for independent real z,L by rational algebra. The four residuals are shown to be genuine value/partial derivatives of the unsolved certificate, with its prescribed constant term and b^3/b^2 rescalings proved. Nonvanishing conditions are discharged on the stated branch, yielding exactly the published coefficients; the existing complete signs and all four contacts remain linked.
